modules.title: 一句“帮我查日程”怎样变成可确认的结果
模型、应用与工具分别做了什么

items.title: 应用提供工具定义
items.text: 应用把“查询日历”能接收哪些时间参数、谁可使用它，以及本次问题一起交给模型。

items.title: 模型返回结构化请求
items.text: 模型返回要调用哪个工具和查询什么时间的结构化请求；这还不是已经查到了日程。

items.title: 结果经模型回到界面
items.text: 应用校验并查询日历，把真实结果交回模型；模型生成回答，再由应用展示给你。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 模型、AI 应用和工具不是同一个东西：模型生成输出，应用负责流程与权限，工具才连接外部数据或动作。

lessonPractice.title: 日历助手回答“明天下午有两场会”，但产品从未给它日历权限，也没有调用日历接口。应该怎样修正？

options.label: 由应用申请权限并调用日历工具，再把真实结果交给 AI 组织回答
options.feedback: AI 只能根据收到的上下文和工具结果回答，真实日程必须由受控产品能力读取。

options.label: 继续让模型根据用户语气推测日程，不需要连接实际日历
options.feedback: 语言模型无法凭空知道私人数据，推测会把不存在的信息当成真实结果。

options.label: 只在提示词中要求“必须查询日历”，并把回答当作已执行
options.feedback: 提示词不能创造工具和权限，是否查询必须由应用实际调用记录证明。

en.title: A calendar assistant says there are two meetings tomorrow afternoon, but the product has no calendar permission and made no calendar call. How should this be fixed?

options.label: Have the app request permission, call the calendar tool, and give real results to the AI for wording
options.feedback: AI answers from supplied context and tool results; private schedules require a controlled product capability.

options.label: Let the model infer meetings from the user's tone without connecting a real calendar
options.feedback: A language model cannot know private data without access, so inference turns invented information into a claimed result.

options.label: Write You must query the calendar in the prompt and treat the response as executed
options.feedback: A prompt creates neither tools nor permission; actual execution requires an application call record.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先确认用户授权和可用的日历工具，实际查询明天下午的日程后再回答。若没有权限或调用失败，明确说明无法读取，不要猜测会议；展示结果时保留时间、标题和数据来源。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Confirm user permission and an available calendar tool, then query tomorrow afternoon before answering. If permission is missing or the call fails, say the schedule cannot be read and do not guess; preserve time, title, and source.

learning.assumes: You have used a chat product that gives continuing answers or shows that it is working.
learning.outcome: You can explain what the model, tool, and application each do when an assistant checks a calendar.

modules.title: Turn “check my calendar” into a result you can verify
What the model, app, and tool each do

items.title: The app describes the tool
items.text: It supplies the calendar tool’s allowed parameters, permissions, and the current question.

items.title: The model requests an action
items.text: It returns a structured request to call the right tool; that is not a calendar result yet.

items.title: The app returns a real result
items.text: It validates the request, queries the calendar, and gives the result back for a response.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: The model generates output, the application handles the flow and permissions, and the tool connects to outside data or actions.
